Markets.title: US stocks today: US stocks end higher as Fed holds rates; focus turns to earnings
Markets.summary: US stocks ended higher after the Federal Reserve kept interest rates unchanged. The market was also boosted by strong earnings from chipmaker SK Hynix.

Markets.title: Fed's Kevin Warsh says US economy not running too hot from AI boom
Markets.summary: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh stated on Wednesday that the U.S. economy is not overheating despite increased demand from the artificial intelligence boom. He noted that ongoing AI investments are creating some pressure, but the overall economic pace remains manageable.

Markets.title: Wendy’s draws buyout bid as beef costs and burger rivalry weigh on business
Markets.summary: Nelson Peltz’s Trian Fund Management offered $7.35 per share to take Wendy’s private, causing the chain's stock to jump. The buyout bid comes as Wendy's struggles with high beef costs, weaker consumer demand, store closures, and fierce fast-food competition.

Markets.title: US Federal Reserve holds interest rates steady as stubborn inflation puts future rate hikes in focus
Markets.summary: The US Federal Reserve kept its benchmark interest rate unchanged to assess inflation trends driven by rising energy prices and tariffs. Policymakers are evaluating these economic pressures as traders closely monitor upcoming data releases.

Markets.title: World Bank sees commodity prices surging 23% in 2026 on Middle East war
Markets.summary: The World Bank projects commodity prices will surge 23% in 2026 due to Middle East conflict disruptions to energy supplies and shipping. The bank warned that further escalation and severe weather could worsen global inflation and food security risks.

Markets.title: Satin Creditcare Q2 profit surges over three-fold as asset quality improves
Markets.summary: Satin Creditcare Network reported a more than three-fold increase in consolidated net profit to Rs 176 crore for the second quarter. This financial growth was driven by portfolio expansion, lower microfinance provisions, and an improvement in the gross NPA ratio to 1.9%.

Geo-Political.title: Flávio Bolsonaro lands in Miami after defeat in Brazil's presidential election
Geo-Political.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro arrived in Miami following his father's defeat in the Brazilian presidential election. His arrival in the United States resolved speculation about his location after he defied an order to surrender his passports.

Geo-Political.title: Netanyahu's bloc leading Israel election but short of majority, partial results show
Geo-Political.summary: Partial election results show Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc winning 53 of the 120 seats in Israel's Knesset with 85% of ballots counted. This total leaves the alliance currently short of the majority needed to form a government.

Geo-Political.title: How could Israel break election deadlock? Here are four scenarios
Geo-Political.summary: Following an Israeli election where 85% of the votes counted indicate a political impasse, new elections emerge as the most likely outcome. The article outlines four potential scenarios for resolving this deadlock.

Geo-Political.title: Luxury cruise passengers stranded in Cambodia due to soaring fuel costs
Geo-Political.summary: The Villa Vie Odyssey luxury cruise suspended its voyage in Cambodia due to soaring fuel costs. The company is currently working with stranded passengers to arrange temporary living situations.

Geo-Political.title: Serbian shot dead after attacking officer outside Israeli embassy, minister says
Geo-Political.summary: A Serbian teenager was shot and killed after attacking a police officer with a crossbow outside the Israeli embassy in Belgrade. Authorities confirmed that the underage attacker was already under surveillance by security services prior to the incident.

Geo-Political.title: Tanzania celebrates first natural gas discovery in more than 10 years
Geo-Political.summary: Tanzania has announced its first natural gas discovery in over a decade. The energy minister has described this new find as a major milestone for the country.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator recently discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best course in that category. This organic visibility occurred without any paid advertising or traditional search engine optimization.

AI & Tech.summary: This article lists ten essential artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These tools aim to help digital creators stay competitive and streamline their workflow.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transitioned into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated content.

Data & Insights.title: India’s public debt ratio to fall to 75.1% of GDP by FY32, only major emerging economy set for a decline: RBI DG
Data & Insights.summary: RBI Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta stated that India's public debt ratio is projected to drop from 84.3% of GDP in FY26 to 75.1% by FY32. India is the only major emerging market economy with a GDP exceeding $1 trillion expected to reduce its debt ratio during this period.

Data & Insights.title: Industrial output growth a tad slower at 6.7% in September, expansion led by manufacturing, electricity generation
Data & Insights.summary: India's industrial output growth slowed to 6.7% in September from 8% in August. This expansion was driven by strong performances in manufacturing and electricity generation, despite a decline in mining.

Data & Insights.title: Cabinet approves PM Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana for 2026-31 with  ₹7,395 crore outlay to strengthen Panchayat governance
Data & Insights.summary: The Union Cabinet approved the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana with a ₹7,395.55 crore outlay for 2026-31 to strengthen Panchayat governance. The scheme will benefit about 32 lakh elected representatives and functionaries across more than 2.55 lakh Panchayats and traditional local bodies.

Data & Insights.title: India's industrial output growth slows to 6.7% in September as manufacturing, consumer durables lose momentum
Data & Insights.summary: India's industrial output growth slowed to 6.7% in September from 7.8% in August, missing market expectations of 7.3%. The slowdown was driven by moderated manufacturing and electricity growth, alongside a 6.2% contraction in the mining sector.

Data & Insights.title: ‘Will disrupt business during Diwali’: Delhi traders' body writes to Rahul Gandhi over November 1 Ramlila Maidan march
Data & Insights.summary: The Chamber of Trade and Industry asked Rahul Gandhi to meet regarding the opposition's planned November 1 Ramlila Maidan rally. Traders warned the march could disrupt 20 nearby markets and cause up to ₹10,000 crore in losses ahead of Diwali.

Data & Insights.title: Why China is defying global inflationary tide—and what it means for the world
Data & Insights.summary: While a global energy crisis drives up worldwide inflation, China's inflation remains low due to a severe housing slump and deep structural economic flaws. This domestic weakness threatens to create negative economic spillovers for the rest of the world.

India.title: From King Edward III To Neha Bora, A 1361 Law Lives On In 'Peace Bonds': NDTV Explains
India.summary: Activists Abhijeet Dipke, Saurav Das, and Ashutosh Ranka signed peace bonds under a 1361 English law, with two facing jail for an alleged breach. Student leader Neha Bora questioned the logic of these bonds, prompting an examination of their history and current use.

India.title: House Vandalised During Arunachal Dam Protest, Ex-Minister Calls For Talks
India.summary: A house was vandalized during a protest against a dam project in Arunachal Pradesh. Former minister Ninong Ering condemned the violence while urging all parties to engage in peaceful dialogue.

India.title: 10 Lakh Target, Anti-SIR Push: Congress Strategy For November 1 Ramlila Maidan Rally
India.summary: Congress MP Nasir Hussain stated that the party aims to gather 10 lakh people for the November 1 Ramlila Maidan rally with an anti-SIR push. He noted that ensuring the success of this event is the collective responsibility of all INDIA alliance parties.

India.title: BJP Ahead But Akhilesh Yadav's Party Gains Ground In UP MLC Elections
India.summary: The BJP won six of the first ten declared seats in the Uttar Pradesh Legislative Council elections. Akhilesh Yadav's Samajwadi Party gained ground by securing the remaining four seats.

India.title: Akal Takht Jathedar Flags Punjab's Drug Menace At UK Parliament
India.summary: Giani Kuldip Singh Gargajj, the Jathedar of Sri Akal Takht Sahib, addressed Punjab's severe youth drug addiction crisis at the UK Parliament. He emphasized the need for a comprehensive strategy that combines cutting off drug supplies with providing effective rehabilitation.

India.title: India Closely Monitoring Tehran Talks Involving Pakistan, Says Centre
India.summary: India is closely monitoring diplomatic talks in Tehran involving Pakistan, which are focused on regional de-escalation. Iran is reportedly facilitating these negotiations to secure a ceasefire between Saudi Arabia and Yemen's Houthi group.

General.summary: In his first Budget, Chancellor Healey announced a £100 payment for energy bills and introduced a new bank tax to help citizens facing global economic turmoil. While the measures aim to ease the cost of living, opposition parties criticized the plans for lacking sufficient boldness.
